own_summary: Built-in browser interface and API are different paths; alias identifies the model, health and model list are not task replies.
Existing Open WebUI has provider connections and selects models. Endpoint choice determines where requests go.
Connection uses /v1. A local server without keys and a secured server require different auth settings. Native process and container addresses differ.
New frontend installation is separate from backend installation. Current docs contain several distribution modes; this extension assumes an existing frontend.
